purpose: Correct the three original CAB scene microphone shapes, mounting and cabinet-facing presentation.
post_processing: None. Selected generated transparent PNGs copied byte-for-byte into the project. Runtime scales each sprite uniformly and places measured capsule/mount/XLR anchors.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite for a real guitar/bass cabinet microphone scene inside the Chimera plugin. Input image is the previous Chimera original microphone design reference; preserve its materials and family identity but correct its physical perspective, proportions and mounting. Render only one microphone, physically straight, isolated on actual transparent alpha. Neutral studio product lighting from upper left, subdued dark gunmetal, restrained metal accent. Not an interface or a complete scene. No text, logos, background, halo, floor, detached components, stand, or cable; the application supplies stand/cable. Three-quarter side/back view from slightly above: this mic is in front of a vertical loudspeaker, its acoustic receiving side points INTO the cabinet (away from the camera, slightly up-left). The viewer must see its side and back, not a front-facing portrait of the grille. Crisp photorealistic 3D product render, mechanically plausible, no bending. Subject: original Attack Dynamic, a slim end-address instrument dynamic mic with narrow short flat-topped mesh head, thin bronze collar, matte dark straight gently tapering barrel and a small black clip around the rear third. The microphone lies in a diagonal nearly horizontal 3D orientation: mesh capsule at upper-left image position (roughly 23% x,34% y), rear XLR barrel at lower-right (roughly 78% x,65% y); straight long axis 28 degrees below horizontal. Capsule is at the far end facing away/up-left; XLR socket is at the near end, lower-right, with its black connector lip visible. Capsule head diameter about 20% of entire length, not a large vocal ball grille. Include compact clamp directly beneath barrel at 60% of length with an unobtrusive threaded stand socket, no extended stand. Whole object fits with 12% clear transparent margin. Landscape canvas.
